subject: Reminder: Payment Due for Your Monthly Subscription
body: Dear valued customer, We hope this email finds you well. This is a friendly reminder that the payment for your monthly subscription is due in 3 days. To avoid any service interruptions, please ensure that your payment is processed on time. Thank you for being a loyal subscriber and for your continued support. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. Sincerely, The Subscription Service Team
